मिल् (probably an old denomin. based on a noun derived from मिश्ल (= मिश्र), changed to मिल्ल), i. 6, Par. Ātm.
 1. To associate, Pañc. 220, 13.
 2. To be connected, 229, 11 (पृष्ठ आगत्य मिलितः, Was the last).
 3. To meet,

.
 --Ptcple. pf. pass. मिलित, Mixed (covered), Pañc. 122, 11.
 --With परि परि, परिमिलित, Penetrated, filled, Śiś. 11, 23.
 --With सम् सम्, संमिलित, Collected, Pañc. 229, 5.
मील् (originally a denomin. based on a noun derived from मिस्ह् by an affix, with initial ल्), i. 1,
. To wink, to contract the eyelids, to close the eyes,

. To be closed of itself (viz. the eyes), Bhaṭṭ. 14, 54.
 3. To be collected, Utt.

(with v. r.).
 --Comp. ptcple. pf. pass. ईषन्मीलित, i. e. ईषत्- adj. Closed a little,

.
 --Caus. मीलय, To close (viz. one's [] eyes), लोचने मीलयित्वा, Like a moment,

.
 --With the prep. अभि अभि, To close (viz. one's eyes),

.
 --With आ आ, To close (viz. one's eyes), Daśak. in

.
 --With उद् उद्,
 1. To open one's eyes,

. To be opened of itself (as one's eyes), Bhaṭṭ. 16, 8.
 3. To open,

; (one's eyes), Vikr. d. 5.
 4. To show, Daśak. in

.
 --With प्रोद् प्र-उद्, To open one's eyes,

.
 --With समुद् सम्-उद्, To open of itself, to spring up,

. To cause to shut the eyes, to kill, Pañc. iii. d. 269.
 2. To close, Ṛt. 6, 26.
 --With विनि वि-नि, To close the eyes, Bhaṭṭ. 11, 9.
 --With प्र प्र, To close the eyes,

.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To close (viz. the eyes),
. To cause to shut the eyes, to make insensible, Utt.
